entities.name: Parmelia sulcata
observations: Methanolic extract induced dose-dependent anti-proliferative effects and apoptosis-like death in A549, PC3, Hep3B, and C6 cells at 1.56–100 μg/mL; reported pyknosis, caspase-cleaved cytokeratin-18, caspase-3 activity, and PARP cleavage. PMID:25081971.
Methanolic extract caused significant comet-assay genetic damage in tested cancer-cell models; accessible abstract lacks numeric comet parameters. PMID:25081971.
Phenolic-extract-derived nanosilver showed apoptosis-associated activity in MCF-7 cells, but accessible abstract did not establish direct DNA damage. PMID:34048745.

entities.name: Usnea filipendula
observations: Methanolic extract induced dose-dependent anti-proliferative effects and apoptosis-like death in A549, PC3, Hep3B, and C6 cells at 1.56–100 μg/mL; reported pyknosis, caspase-cleaved cytokeratin-18, caspase-3 activity, and PARP cleavage. PMID:25081971.
Methanolic extract caused significant comet-assay genetic damage in tested cancer-cell models; accessible abstract lacks numeric comet parameters. PMID:25081971.

No additional qualifying primary cancer-cell study with extract or metabolite concentrations and direct DNA-damage measurements was identified. PMID:38027904 concerns Usnea diffracta, not U. filipendula.

entities.name: PMID:25081971
observations: Methanolic extracts of Parmelia sulcata and Usnea filipendula were tested in A549, PC3, Hep3B, and C6 cells; viability, apoptosis-associated markers, and comet-assay genetic damage were assessed. Species-specific effect sizes were not available in the accessible abstract. PMID:25081971.

entities.name: PMID:34048745
observations: A phenolic Parmelia sulcata extract-derived nanosilver formulation showed apoptosis-associated effects in MCF-7 cells, but accessible abstract did not report a direct DNA-damage assay. PMID:34048745.

entities.name: Apoptosis-like death
observations: Both lichen methanolic extracts produced pyknosis and apoptosis-associated caspase-3, cleaved cytokeratin-18, and PARP-cleavage findings in cancer-cell models. PMID:25081971.

entities.name: Comet-assay genetic damage
observations: Both lichen methanolic extracts significantly increased genetic damage in comet assays in the tested cell models; numeric comet parameters were unavailable in the accessible abstract. PMID:25081971.
